ValidationRule.description: Block edits to Negotiation fields once status is "Approved by Controller"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Controlling User'
&& ( ISCHANGED(Approval_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(Indexation_Rate_Billed__c) || ISCHANGED(Market_Flow__c) || ISCHANGED(Controlling_Validation__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to change approval fields
